movelist.name: False Swipe
movelist.effect: False Swipe’s damage cannot bring a target lower than 1 Hit Point.

movelist.name: Rage
movelist.effect: The user becomes Enraged. Until the end of the user’s next turn, if the user is Enraged, the user gains +1 Attack Combat Stage whenever they are damaged by an Damaging Move or Attack.

movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Bone Wielder
abilities.effect: The user’s Bone Club, Bonemerang, and Bone Rush Moves ignore immunity against Ground-Type Moves.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.effect: The user ignores the Recoil keyword when attacking. If the user moves at least 4 meters in a straight line towards a foe before attacking that foe with a physical attack, they may add a +2d6 Bonus to the Damage Roll against that foe.
